title: のんびりキャンプ
subject_en: Cosy camping items and tiny scenes in picture-book style, each a separate item (tent, campfire, lantern, cooking gear, a person in a warm jacket where noted with a round friendly face). No brand names. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: テント、たき火、ランタン、ホットサンド。冬も楽しいのんびりキャンプの道具と場面12点。アウトドアのブログやチラシに。
items: a dome tent with an open flap and a warm light inside
a campfire made of crossed logs with orange flames and sparks
a glowing camping lantern with a handle
a hot sandwich maker with a toasted sandwich cut in half
a stick with two toasted marshmallows over a small flame
a folding camp chair with a blanket and a mug on its arm
a rolled out sleeping bag with a pillow and a tiny star pattern
a small camping kettle on a stove with steam
a person in a puffy jacket and beanie warming hands by a fire
the back view of a person sitting on a chair looking at stars from beside a tent
a big hiking backpack with a rolled mat and a hanging mug
a steaming enamel mug of cocoa beside a small wrapped blanket
